The dive blends the hold's own track into the close side's own track, the rise the close side's track into the travel's, in coordinates about the eye of the storm (log of height, arc and azimuth of the point under the camera, orientation against a look at the eye, field of view). The weight is a trapezoid of rate: rampIn and rampOut are the shares of the segment over which the rate rises from the first track's and falls to the last track's. at is the share of the segment where the side changes (T).
